parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6, resulting in val_bpb dropping from 1.1065 to 1.0127. The scaling seems promising. Next, I will investigate if increasing the ASPECT_RATIO or adjusting the MATRIX_LR can further optimize this deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Scaling up architecture depth and aspect ratio while slightly lowering learning rate for stability.
